From: Jeff Moss <detroitsportsrag@gmail.com>
Date: July 6, 2019 at 9:18:10 AM EDT
To: cdthomas@freepress.com
Subject: Anthony Fenech
I have been advised by multiple sources that neither the Free Press or Anthony Fenech reimbursed the Detroit Tigers for the 2019 Fantasy Camp that Fenech attended.
Thus, this was approximately a $4,000.00 gift from the team to the man who covers their team for your paper.
Would you care to comment on that? Or the appropriateness of your Tigers beat writer wearing the team's jersey?
